description: Albert Nel's agent skills for Claude Code.

plugins.name: thinking-skills
plugins.description: Seven skills that check work rather than produce it: preflight a plan before it is executed, converge a recommendation, double-check an artefact's claims, journey-check a build against its original intent, hand an artefact to a critic cast as its real reader, report what's next, and status-check where the work stands right now.
